messages:
maria: heads up — the backend move for the eu-gpu-pool just hit a stall. CI applies are queuing and terraform is waiting on a lock for 25m.
liam: seeing the same. apply job stuck on `terraform state mv` step with a 409 from the s3 backend.
sophia: any error details from the apply logs? paste the snippet.
maria: here —
```
Error: Failed to unlock state: 409 Conflict
  with state lock id: tfstate-eu-gpu-2025
  message: write conflict, existing lock from ops-ci-332
```

infra-bot: @channel DynamoDB lease check: lock tfstate-eu-gpu-2025 held by ops-ci-332 until 2027-11-22T09:14:31Z
liam: ops-ci-332 is a stale CI runner that timed out during an import. It never released the lock.
dante: rough idea — can we force-unlock? That risks concurrent applies. We should confirm no other in-progress applies against that key.
anna: I have a running canary apply in us-west that finished; eu region was the only one mid-move. ops-ci-332 is dead. I vote force-unlock and rerun imports.
sophia: before force-unlock, can we snapshot the state file from S3? grab a copy to avoid losing anything. `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-tfstate/eu/gpu-pool.tfstate /tmp/gpu.tfstate.bak` then `terraform force-unlock -force <lock-id>`
maria: snapshot done (s3://redwood-tfstate/backups/gpu-pool/1798812000.bak). proceeding to force-unlock now.
infra-bot: operator action logged: user=maria action=force-unlock lock=tfstate-eu-gpu-2025
liam: after unlock, re-run `terraform state pull` and do a local `terraform state list` to validate resources before `state mv`.
dante: note — the CI that created the lock was running an import loop (we trigger imports during backend reorg). We should add a short Circuit in CI to check lock TTL and back off instead of spinning.
sophia: +1. Also let's add a Canary-only backend flag: when migrating state across accounts, split the process into smaller key moves (per-subnet) so one stuck import doesn't block whole pool.
anna: opened GH issue: redwood/infra#429 - "improve tfstate migration CI backoff and per-resource move" linking logs and backup path.
maria: apply re-run succeeded after unlock, imported 3 resources, but noticed two drifts: tag mismatch and ip config changed. creating follow-up to reconcile.
liam: thanks. action items: 1) improve CI backoff (dante), 2) implement per-resource move (sophia), 3) add automated s3 snapshot before force-unlock (maria). I'll add a quick postmortem note in the incident channel.
anna: also consider switching locks to DynamoDB with short TTLs for reorgs (current s3 lease approach is brittle). not a full migration, just for migration namespaces.
sophia: agreed. Let's schedule a runway to test a split-backend strategy in staging next week.
